findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: portfolio_list_blog_posts, portfolio_get_blog_post, portfolio_search · Public sink: portfolio_get_blog_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: portfolio_list_blog_posts, portfolio_get_blog_post, portfolio_search · Public sink: portfolio_get_blog_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
